title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P05: The watched pot (act break)
summary: The sprout grows only when Sam isn't looking. 'It only grows when nobody's looking.'

lines.text: You know... a watched pot never boils.
lines.tts: [wise, calm] You know... a watched pot never boils.
lines.note: The gap holds the '5 minutes later...' card (1.6 s) + CU of Sam's twitching eye (1 s).

lines.text: That's for pots, Layla. Trees are totally different. Trees are—
lines.tts: [lecturing] That's for pots, Layla. Trees are totally different. Trees are—
lines.note: WS: he turns to Layla, his BACK to the mound. Behind him the sprout POPS up on 'different'. Layla's eyes widen.
He whips round: the sprout freezes (tiny innocent wiggle). Silent rule of three in the next gap: turns away -> it grows (whoosh); whips back -> frozen.
Squints at the sprout, nose to leaf.

lines.tts: [dry, hiding a smile] Maybe it's shy.

lines.note: He turns back to Layla -> behind him a second leaf unfurls; Pip lands and chirps at it.
Slow, slow head turn... frozen again.

lines.tts: [dramatic whisper] It only grows... when nobody's looking.
lines.note: Slow push-in CU; dramatic sting (ACT BREAK).

lines.tts: [conspiratorial] Layla. This calls for a plan.
lines.note: CU, eyebrows down, slow nod. Whoosh to the next part.

beats: OPEN (0-5.6 s): '5 minutes later...' card (1.6 s), then, extreme CU of Sam's eyes vs the mound (tension cue), eye twitch.
l4 gap: the peekaboo rule of three — turn away (whoosh, it grows), whip back (frozen); twice; the third time he fakes the turn and it almost gets caught.
